summary: Frontend-only verification of Split Systems cleanup + mobile brand row + brand page redesign. Ran Playwright at 375x812 (mobile) and 1440x900 (desktop). All 12 test areas from the review request passed: mobile-brand-row visible with 4 correct labeled links, horizontally scrollable (scrollWidth 586 > clientWidth 375, class overflow-x-auto), Daikin nav works; desktop top brand-pricing-nav hidden on mobile (offsetParent null, classes contain 'hidden lg:block'); on desktop mobile-brand-row has 'lg:hidden' and offsetHeight=0 while brand-pricing-nav is visible showing 4 brand cards (Daikin/Rinnai/Mitsubishi Electric/Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, no 'undefined'); Daikin/Rinnai/Mitsubishi Electric/Mitsubishi Heavy Industries brand pages render all expected ranges with correct features lines, prices and disclaimers; mitsubishi-electric H1 contains 'Mitsubishi Electric' and range title contains 'MSZ-AP Series'; pre-fill flow works — submit label 'Book Daikin Cora 3.5kW', message contains Daikin/Cora/3.5kW/$1,700, brand-selected-summary contains $1,700; TrustBadges removed on brand pages; sibling-brands present with 3 sibling links; regression pages (/, /ducted, /cleaning, /repairs, /servicing) all 200; /gallery still has 4 rotate-90 elements.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: BrandNav's default `heading` and `sub` are still declared even though every call site now passes them explicitly — dead default values.

Minor console warning on / page: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' Likely from Lenis scrollTo target; harmless but worth checking the exclusivity/reserve section container positioning.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All acceptance checks from iteration 12 review passed. Mobile viewport uses [data-testid='mobile-brand-row']; desktop hides mobile row via lg:hidden and shows brand-pricing-nav (which itself is hidden on mobile via 'hidden lg:block'). BrandPage removes TrustBadges and has compact sibling-brands chip row. Book-btn testid format: book-btn-{rangeSlug}-{kwStrippedOfNonAlnum}, e.g. book-btn-cora-35kW.
